The largest, most demanding enterprises run on Baseten, and they bring exacting requirements for how people, services, and agents access the platform. You'll own the identity and access layer of the Baseten platform: the authorization model, credential systems, and admin experiences that enterprise IT teams use to govern access for organizations like Harvey, HubSpot, and Notion.

You'll design and build Baseten's fine-grained authorization system from the ground up to support the workflows customers depend on today while giving them cleaner, more precise ways to manage access as the platform grows. - Admin controls for centralized visibility, auditability, and governance over credentials, roles, and access

- Lead identity and authorization projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, launch, and iteration.

- Establish engineering practices for quality, security, observability, and operational ownership.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship as the team grows.

- Experience developing and operating multi-tenant systems at scale, where authorization checks sit in the request path and latency and consistency matter.

- Comfort working across the full stack, from product and application code to cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Python and Go.

- Experience running an OpenFGA, SpiceDB, or similar deployment in production, beyond a proof of concept.

- Working knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, and SCIM at the protocol level.

Edge is our heavy hitter when all else fails. It runs a Rust peer runtime on residential Windows PCs that long-polls our command-and-control service over mTLS gRPC, making fetches look indistinguishable from real human traffic using genuine hardware, residential IPs, and seamless fingerprints.
Our Edge Platform squad manages both the control plane and data plane of this stack. Mobile is where our biggest opportunity lies: websites that block desktop traffic often welcome a real mobile phone on a 4G connection. That’s where you come in! • Bring Edge to mobile platforms: Port our peer to Android using NDK/JNI, navigating foreground services, battery optimizations, and mobile network quirks to integrate real and emulated device farms into our fleet.

• Master the FFI boundary: Integrate the Chromium network stack (Cronet, C++) and browserless HTTP clients into the peer as clean, well-tested Rust libraries with safe runtime contracts.

description:
Senior Engineer, Operational Excellence

Location: Irving, TX

The Senior Engineer, Operational Excellence is a site-based continuous improvement engineer at our Irving, TX distribution center. You will work side by side with operators and site leadership to find the recurring problems that drive efficiency and quality losses, then solve them with data, lean tools, and DMAIC.

You will be the site leader's go-to for problems and solutions, and will trial new continuous improvement initiatives locally. You will take them to completion and feed what works back to shared resources so it can be standardized across the network.

You Will…

• Monitor site efficiency and quality trends to identify recurring gaps across people, processes, and equipment.

• Lead continuous improvement projects using DMAIC, from project charter through implementation and control, delivering measurable results.

• Own the site's continuous improvement roadmap, project pipeline, and CI tracker.

• Identify problems, establish root causes, and implement sustainable solutions using data and Lean methodologies.

• Partner with site leadership, operators, central engineering, and corporate teams to develop and execute improvement initiatives.

• Support site engineering activities, including slotting, standard headcount, order allocation, AutoCAD updates, SOPs, and success guides.

• Lead and support 5S initiatives, Gemba walks, Kaizen events, and other Lean activities.

• Analyze site performance data and leverage Claude AI to conduct deep dives, develop insights, and build and test tools.

• Coach and mentor operations teams, peers, and teammates on continuous improvement practices.

• Participate in daily production meetings, planning standups, weekly operations reviews, and local area leader meetings.

• Maintain site administrative standards, including visual management, floor layout maps, and material staging.

• Pilot new continuous improvement initiatives locally, measure their success, and share best practices to support standardization across the network.

You Are…

• Operator-first, collaborative, and comfortable working directly alongside frontline operators.

• Data-driven, using facts and measurable results to guide decisions.

• A strong problem solver who focuses on identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.

• A proactive leader who takes ownership of operational gaps and drives solutions through completion.

• An effective communicator who can influence and collaborate across teams without direct authority.

• Action-oriented, with a bias for moving quickly from identifying problems to implementing solutions.

• A continuous improvement advocate who builds relationships, coaches others, and promotes a culture of operational excellence.

• Adaptable and comfortable navigating both hands-on operational challenges and strategic improvement initiatives.

You Have…

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• At least 5 years of experience in a production or manufacturing environment, with a demonstrated track record of continuous improvement.

• Hands-on experience leading DMAIC or other structured problem-solving initiatives with measurable results.

• Strong project management skills, including project scoping, problem statements, goal setting, and timeline management.

• Working knowledge of Lean tools and methodologies, including:

• Value Stream Mapping

• 5 Whys and Fishbone Diagrams

• 5S and Standard Work

• Statistical Process Control (SPC)

• Pareto Analysis

• A3 and Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

• Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including basic statistics, control charts, hypothesis testing, and capability analysis.

• Working knowledge of AI tools, specifically Claude, including prompt writing, validating outputs, analyzing data, and drafting documents.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with AutoStore or other robotic goods-to-person systems.

Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. title: Systems Administrator
description:
Parasol Alliance is a technology solutions company exclusively serving the senior living industry. We provide leadership and comprehensive in-house technology support, helping our clients make smart strategic technology investments and effectively use technology to achieve their business objectives.

Our strategic focus forms the core of Parasol Partnerships. These partnerships lead to increased efficiency, productivity, and profitability for our clients. We make our clients more successful - and we have the data to prove it.

Leadership defines us. We are innovative leaders in everything we do.

The systems administrator will be responsible for level two systems administration support for Parasol’s clients. The administrator will also be responsible for onsite technical support as determined by client needs. The administrator’s focus will be primarily on systems and server related tickets as well as tickets escalated from the service desk.

Responsibilities

• Level 2 support for client issues.

• System support for servers, virtualization and email environments.

• In depth problem solving for servers and systems.

• Detailed documentation within service tickets on issue steps and resolution.

• Excellent customer service on the phone, via email and in person.

Requirements

• Healthcare experience preferred; long-term healthcare support experience is a plus.

• At least five years of systems administration experience in an enterprise environment.

• At least five years’ experience working with systems support, configuration and management.

• Experience with multiple enterprise systems such as Active Directory, Microsoft Server, Windows Operating Systems, file shares, printers and copiers, phone systems, Exchange, basic network support, desktop hardware support.

• Excellent communication and customer service skills are required.

• The position is largely self-motivated and self-structured. The right candidate will be driven to be challenged and to succeed.

Position Metrics

• The Systems Administrator must adhere to established policies and standards as defined in The Culture File.

•

• Metric: Customer notifications completed within standards 95% each quarter

• Metric: Ticket and phone audit criteria met 90% each quarter

• Metric: project tasks are completed within standards 90% each quarter

• The Systems Administrator is responsible for assisting in the design of internal Parasol Alliance systems and tools for optimal security and performance management.

•
• Metric: training videos created once/month.

Position Expectations

Within the first 30 days the Systems Administrator will be accountable for:

• Learning and adhering to established policies and standards as defined in The Culture File

• Learning and leveraging Parasol provided tools and systems

• Demonstrating competency in role responsibilities based on the above metrics

Within the first 60 days the Systems Administrator will be accountable for:

• Meeting and maintaining the above metrics while carrying a ticket load of 15-20 tickets

Benefits

• Cell phone/internet reimbursement

• Medical, dental, vision, 401k

• Responsible paid time off

• Certification reimbursement

Company Culture

We are an IT company but believe technology support should be directly related to your business success. Technology for technology’s sake is not what we are about. We intertwine the knowledge economy with technology to transform and interconnect our expertise with your company to expand the decision-making capabilities and ensure productivity and cost effectiveness.

Our Values:

•Expertise

•Collaboration

•Empathy

•Integrity

If you want to work for a values driven, high performance company and to experience an exciting opportunity to help grow a company then this is the job for you. We are looking for our team members to take ownership and pride in their work, and to provide input and guidance into not only the clients of Parasol but the growth of Parasol itself.

About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role
Megaport is building a serverless edge compute platform that runs customer workloads as isolated microVMs on bare metal in our own facilities, directly inside the customer's private network. This role owns the control plane: everything from the customer's terminal to the Kubernetes API. You will be the engineer who makes the platform deployable, highly available across regions, and operable in production.

title: Director, B2B Media Strategy
description:
The Role

As the Director of B2B Media Strategy at Wpromote, you’ll help enterprise and high-growth clients turn complex business goals into measurable marketing success. This is an individual contributor role, focused on leading strategic direction and cross-channel integration rather than direct people management. You’ll build integrated go-to-market strategies that connect media, operations, and revenue alignment-driving real impact from first impression to closed-won deal.

What you’ll focus on:
- Media strategy: Shape the right channel mix, audience targeting, creative approach, and measurement framework using the latest B2B martech, adtech, and datatech tools.
- Operational consulting: Apply proven frameworks to design scalable, high-performing media and data systems.
- Revenue alignment: Partner with sales and marketing to close the gap between awareness and revenue, speeding up pipeline growth.
- Messaging strategy: Match the right message with the right audience to move accounts through the funnel efficiently.

You’ll work closely with channel experts, client services, and analytics teams while collaborating directly with client-side sales and marketing leaders. This role is ideal for someone with deep B2B expertise, strong executive presence, and the ability to turn strategic vision into hands-on execution in a fast-paced, competitive space.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-Flexible schedules
-Work from anywhere options*
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
 
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $134,000- $155,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above) and an annual performance bonus.

This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed and you must be an active employee in good standing and not on a Performance Improvement Plan to be eligible for the annual bonus.
